EN: May this armor protect you from harm.
ZH: 希望这件装甲能够保护你们免受伤害。

EN: The treasures of our land are yours.
ZH: 城堡里的财富都是你们的。

EN: Our blacksmiths may have something of interest. Here.
ZH: 我们的铸铁匠有些东西你们应该会感兴趣。来，拿着。

EN: You may bow before the king!
ZH: 你们应该向国王敬礼！

EN: My land is generous, and noble.
ZH: 我的城堡美丽又神圣。

EN: You may but name what you seek, and we shall provide it!
ZH: 可以告诉我们你们在找什么，我们会给你们的！

EN: We seek weapons to protect our kingdom!
ZH: 我们想要武器来保卫我们的王国！

EN: We dig the knight outfits. Can we have one?
ZH: 我们很喜欢你们的骑士造型，可以给我们一套吗？

EN: Got any cash, king?
ZH: 国王，可以给我们钱吗？

EN: Any crafting junk in this land of yours?
ZH: 你们的国土里有没有什么可供打造的杂物吗？

EN: Gary! Gary!
ZH: 加里！加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary? Gary!
ZH: 加里？加里！

EN: What's wrong with you?
ZH: 你到底有什么毛病？

EN: Uh... Gary? Gary, Gary?
ZH: 呃……加里？加里，加里？

EN: No one calls us Gary! Attack!
ZH: 没有人敢叫我们加里！给我上！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary! Gary Gary Gary!
ZH: 加里！加里加里加里！

EN: We know the answer to this. It's Gary.
ZH: 我们知道答案。就是加里。

EN: Say something else!
ZH: 敢不敢说点其他词！

EN: That's it. You're all dead.
ZH: 我受够了，去死吧。

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary!
ZH: 加里！

EN: Gary! Gary Gary!
ZH: 加里！加里加里！

EN: (He points to a stash of items. Gifts?)
ZH: （他指向了一堆道具储备。是礼物吗？）

EN: Uh... We'll take the weapon.
ZH: 呃……那我们要武器吧。

EN: That outfit looks nice.
ZH: 那件装备看起来不错。

EN: We're all about that sack of bottlecaps.
ZH: 我们就是为了瓶盖而来的。

EN: That junk looks useful for crafting.
ZH: 那个杂物看起来很适合打造。

EN: Sorry, you lose. Better luck next time!
ZH: 抱歉，你们输了。欢迎下次再来！

EN: You're a winner!
ZH: 你们赢了！

EN: The bets are off and the fix is in!
ZH: 赌注已下，大局已定！

EN: Place your bets! Place your bets!
ZH: 下注了！下注了！

EN: Red or black?
ZH: 红还是黑？

EN: Red?
ZH: 红？

EN: Black.
ZH: 黑色。

EN: We bet on... Death! Kill them!
ZH: 我们把赌注押在……死上！给我杀了他们！

EN: Always your best bet! You win.
ZH: 总是你厉害！你赢了。

EN: Loser!
ZH: 倒霉蛋！

EN: Looks like the house loses!
ZH: 看起来好像庄家输了！

EN: This Vault is devoted to nothing but Lady Luck herself!
ZH: 这个避难所都是为幸运女神而存在的！

EN: I'm going to draw a card. Guess it right and win a prize!
ZH: 我准备抽一张卡。猜对了话就能赢得奖励！

EN: Guess it wrong... and we just might have to kill you.
ZH: 如果猜错了……我们就只能杀了你们了。

EN: Queen of Hearts?
ZH: 红桃Q？

EN: Ace of spades?
ZH: 黑桃A？

EN: How about we kill you first? Attack!
ZH: 先杀了你怎么样？攻击！

EN: Critical hit!
ZH: 暴击！

EN: Take my lucky suit!
ZH: 拿走我的幸运套装吧！

EN: All right. Let's cash you out.
ZH: 行啊，你们把现金拿走吧。

EN: Hey, glad someone finally wants it!
ZH: 嘿，我很高兴有人喜欢这个！

EN: What are the odds? Fellow Dwellers!
ZH: 几率是多大啊？避难所居民们！

EN: I'm the Overseer here. Lady Luck is always on my side!
ZH: 我是这儿的监督者。幸运女神总是站在我这边！

EN: Turns out she's also on your side!
ZH: 看起来她也站在你们那边嘛！

EN: You get one prize of your choice.
ZH: 你们可以自己选择一个奖励。

EN: We like backing up our luck with weaponry.
ZH: 强大的武器才能保证好运。

EN: We'll roll our fortunes on new clothes.
ZH: 我们想用新衣服来招招好运。

EN: We'll take home our winnings in Caps.
ZH: 我们想把胜利兑换成瓶盖带回家。

EN: We'll take that junk in the prize window.
ZH: 我们选择把杂物带回家。

EN: What kind of talk is that? Out of the ring!
ZH: 这说的是什么话？给我滚出场外！

EN: Oh no! Such an awesome move! We're done for!
ZH: 哦不！多么了不起的一步！我们完蛋了！

EN: No holds barred!
ZH: 不留情面！

EN: Step into the ring, Dwellers!
ZH: 居民们，请入场！

EN: Behold our signature move, the Radscorpion Hold!
ZH: 看好了，我们的大招，传说中的“辐射蝎锁”！

EN: Let's see your counter-move!
ZH: 让我们看看你们的回应！

EN: We prefer boxing to wrestling. Sorry.
ZH: 比起摔跤，我们更喜欢拳击。不好意思。

EN: You'll never defeat... The Deathclaw Dive!
ZH: 你们是不可能打败我的……“死爪飞跳”！

EN: Our counter-move is we kill all of you!
ZH: 我们的回应就是我们会把你们都杀了！

EN: A fearsome name to shake the ring for years to come!
ZH: 一个可怕的名字，威震摔跤界多年！

EN: Mocking the ring? Time to knock you down for the count!
ZH: 敢嘲笑我们？信不信我把你们打趴下！

EN: Time to clean up your act!
ZH: 是时候好好修理下你们了！

EN: All disputes in this Vault are solved by wrestling!
ZH: 这个避难所里的所有分歧都是通过摔跤解决的！

EN: You want to stay, you need an awesome wrestling name!
ZH: 你们想留下来的话，会需要一些帅气的艺名！

EN: We are... The Vault Vigilantes!
ZH: 我们是……避难所义警！

EN: Our team name is... The Only Ones Who Aren't Idiots.
ZH: 我们的队名是……“除了我们都是白痴”。

EN: This is dumb, and we're going to murder you.
ZH: 这太蠢了，我们要杀了你们。

EN: Weapons are banned in the ring... But yeah, of course!
ZH: 武器在这里已经被禁止了。不过你们想要的话，拿去吧！

EN: Oh yeah!
ZH: 哦当然！

EN: Here. From my last match.
ZH: 拿着吧，我们最后一场比赛的奖励。

EN: As it so happens, I have this. It's yours!
ZH: 正好我有。都给你们吧！

EN: I am the undisputed Heavy Weight Champion!
ZH: 我毫无疑问就是重量级比赛的冠军！

EN: As Overseer of this Vault, the people look to me!
ZH: 作为避难所的监督者，所有人都唯我马首是瞻！

EN: And I am here to give back to all wrestling fans!
ZH: 我来这里就是为了回馈我的粉丝们！

EN: Got any weapons we can take?
ZH: 有没有什么武器能送给我们吗？

EN: How about a wrestler outfit of our very own?
ZH: 给我们摔跤手的装备怎么样？

EN: Care to share some Caps?
ZH: 愿意分点瓶盖给我们吗？

EN: You guys don't have any junk for crafting, do you?
ZH: 你们有没有什么可以用来打造的杂物？

EN: Vault-Tec wants you to check up on some... experiments we're running in the other Vaults.
ZH: 避难所科技想要你去查看一些……我们在其他避难所做的实验。

EN: Vault-Tec Experiment Review
ZH: 避难所科技实验检阅

EN: Talk to the Vault Dwellers.
ZH: 和避难所居民交谈。

EN: Check in on the experiments in other Vaults.
ZH: 查看其他避难所的实验。

EN: Vault-Tec Saves Christmas!
ZH: 避难所科技拯救了圣诞节！

EN: Welcome, friends, to Vaultopolis.
ZH: 朋友们，欢迎你们来到避难所大都会！

EN: Many seek our sanctuary. Few find it. For we are... utopia.
ZH: 很多人在寻找我们，但很少有人找到。因为我们是……桃花源。

EN: You are from a Vault, no? May yours grow to be as amazing as ours.
ZH: 你们也是来自一个避难所，对吧？希望你们的避难所也能发展成我们这个样子。

EN: You are welcome here always. Take these gifts, and our friendship.
ZH: 我们永远欢迎你们来。拿着这些礼物，还有我们的友谊。

EN: Paula Plumbkin turned out to be an evil Raider wannabe, but at least she gave us the location of Vault 525, otherwise known as Vaultopolis!
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金到头来其实是一个邪恶的掠夺者。但至少她告诉了我们525号避难所的位置。

EN: Vaultopolis Awaits!
ZH: 前往桃花源！

EN: Experience Vaultopolis.
ZH: 体验避难所大都会。

EN: Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley - time to complete our Quest!
ZH: 避难所大都会位于“荫蔽山谷” - 去完成我们的任务吧！

EN: They were headed west - they may have already left the Red Rocket. That's a mile north of here.
ZH: 他们往西边去了— 他们可能已经离开了红火箭。从这往北一英里。

EN: You came here for my husband? Well, you can't have him!
ZH: 你们是为了我的丈夫而来的吗？不好意思，你们可别想得到他！

EN: Cause we sold him to Slavers! Brought in a pretty penny, too.
ZH: 因为我们已经把他卖给了奴隶贩子！狠狠地赚了一笔。

EN: Vault Dwellers always bring in a good price. Clean, healthy, good teeth... Quality stock.
ZH: 避难所居民们总是能卖个好价钱，他们干净，健康，牙齿健全……绝对是硬货。

EN: Hey - are any of you single?
ZH: 嘿—你们当中有单身的吗？

EN: He's not your husband, he's our friend. Where are the Slavers?
ZH: 他不是你的丈夫，他是我们的朋友。奴隶贩子们去哪里了？

EN: I guess we traded Jack for a pet, or Jack traded himself, or something! But he ended up married to a Raider Boss named Kaela who hangs out in a cave...
ZH: 我猜我们把杰克卖了换了个宠物，或者杰克把自己卖了或者其他什么鬼。但是他最后居然和一个住在洞穴里名叫凯拉的掠夺者首领结了婚……

EN: Walk of Shame
ZH: 屈辱之路

EN: Find Kaela the Raider Boss.
ZH: 找到掠夺者首领凯拉。

EN: Jack may still be alive at the Ironworks - but he's married to a Raider?
ZH: 杰克可能还活着，就在钢铁厂——但他好像娶了个掠夺者？

EN: You've got fans of Space Trip - Trippies - and Cosmic Clash adepts.
ZH: 现在有太空旅行的粉丝，趣皮士和宇宙碰撞的行家。

EN: Ah, you're finally here! I was beginning to despair!
ZH: 啊，你终于来了！我都开始绝望了！

EN: Those nerds have started shooting each other over their stupid serials!
ZH: 这些呆子们都快因为这些愚蠢的作品开始互相射击了！

EN: You have to bring them to their senses!
ZH: 赶紧让他们正常点吧！

EN: Also, everyone knows Professor Tempus is the best series of all!
ZH: 而且，谁都知道《田普思教授》是最好的系列！

EN: Right, we'll get right on it. Which are the main factions?
ZH: 好吧，我们会说到的。主要的派系有哪些？

EN: Correct! Let's all lay down our arms and re-read that classic episode.
ZH: 正确！让我们放松，来重温下经典的剧情。

EN: You lie! What else would you use to realign tachyonic flow polarity?
ZH: 你撒谎！你还会用什么来重新调整超光速流极性？

EN: Ugh! Set masers to carbonize!
ZH: 呸！设置微波激射器碳化！

EN: In the name of the Planetary League, I command you to stop!
ZH: 以行星联盟的名义，我命令你停止！

EN: Are you despicable Cosmic Clash nerds, or classy Space Trip aficionados?
ZH: 你是可鄙的宇宙碰撞书呆子，还是一流的太空旅行爱好者？

EN: Only one way to find out, by answering this question.
ZH: 只有通过回答这个问题来找出答案。

EN: When did the Chief Engineer synthesize Technobabblium to save the ship?
ZH: 总工程师是什么时候合成“科技呓语素”来拯救飞船的？

EN: I believe it's vol. 2, issue 7, “Nebulous Intentions.”
ZH: 我相信这是第二卷第七期，“模糊的意图”。

EN: Technobabblium isn't real.
ZH: “科技呓语素”不是真的。

EN: Are you wearing... alien ears?
ZH: 你戴的是……外星耳朵？

EN: You forget our Energy Scimitars! Pkssshiioom... vwoom... vwooom...
ZH: 你忘了我们还有能量弯刀！噗克嘶嘶轰……呜嗡……呜嗡……

EN: Star Council commandos! I knew it!
ZH: 星际议会突击队！我早就知道了！

EN: Our passion *should* bring us together, not push us apart. Thank you, space traveler.
ZH: 同样的热情应该把我们聚在一起，而不是把我们分开。谢谢你，太空旅行者。

EN: Greetings, I am Senator Kari of the Concordat.
ZH: 你好，我是协和会的卡里参议员。

EN: Welcome to our very, very distant nebula.
ZH: 欢迎来到我们非常遥远的星云。

EN: The Cosmic Energy told us of your coming.
ZH: 宇宙能量向我们预示了你们的到来。

EN: Now, we will use it to reveal your intentions.
ZH: 现在，我们将用它来揭示你的意图。

EN: Your superstition is no match for our rusty weapons!
ZH: 你的迷信根本不是我们生锈武器的对手！

EN: Uh uh...
ZH: 呃呃……

EN: We only seek cosmic harmony. The galaxy's big enough for all.
ZH: 我们只追求宇宙的和谐。这个星系足够大了。

EN: We've just received news that a nearby Vault has descended into chaos. It seems fans of pre-war science-fiction novelettes have come to blows over which series is the best. We need to send a team to help pacify the Vault!
ZH: 我们刚刚收到消息说附近的避难所陷入了混乱。似乎那些战前科幻小说的粉丝们已经为哪部最好大打出手了。我们需要派一支队伍去安抚避难所！

EN: War of the Nerds
ZH: 书呆子之战

EN: Pacify the Space Trip fans.
ZH: 安抚太空旅行爱好者。

EN: Pacify the Cosmic Clash fans.
ZH: 安抚宇宙碰撞的粉丝。

EN: Bring peace to warring groups of science-fiction fans.
ZH: 给敌对的科幻迷们带来和平。

EN: Obey the Principal Regulation!
ZH: 遵守主要规定！

EN: May the Cosmic Energy guide your way!
ZH: 愿宇宙能量指引你前进！

EN: You've saved this settlement. Here. You deserve everything we can afford to give!
ZH: 你救了我们，拿着，你值得得到所有我们拥有的东西！

EN: Thank you! Here. It's everything we have.
ZH: 谢谢！拿着。这是我们所有的东西。

EN: You Vault Dwellers are amazing! Thank you!
ZH: 你们这些居民真是太棒了！谢谢！

EN: You're doctors? Thank goodness!
ZH: 你们是医生吗？谢天谢地！

EN: I managed to drag all the sick and wounded here. Can you help us?
ZH: 我把这里所有的病人和受伤者都召集在一起了。你们能帮帮我们吗？

EN: Don't worry. We'll patch you all up.
ZH: 别担心。我们会帮你们包扎好的。

EN: You owe us big time, but I guess we'll help.
ZH: 你们可欠我们不少人情啊，但我想我们还是会帮忙的。

EN: Speedy medical service! Courtesy of your friendly neighborhood Vault!
ZH: 快捷的医疗服务！这是出于避难所邻居的友好礼节！

EN: We've picked up a radio transmission. A nearby settlement has sick and wounded in need of help!
ZH: 我们收到了一个无线电信号。邻近的一个定居点有许多生病和受伤的人需要帮助！

EN: Wasteland Doctoring
ZH: 废土医生

EN: Talk to the settlement leader.
ZH: 与定居点的负责人交谈。

EN: Bring medical aid to a nearby settlement.
ZH: 给邻近的定居点带去医疗帮助。

EN: You came across a small secluded cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
ZH: 你在废土探险时发现了一个小而隐蔽的小屋。也许你该看看里面有什么。

EN: Wasteland Getaway
ZH: 开启废土探险

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: You found a secluded Cabin in the Wasteland.
ZH: 你在废土发现了一处隐蔽的小屋。

EN: ♪ This is it, here I stand! ♪ My first mission, and it's grand! ♪\n♪ Being sent to the Wasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 就是现在，我站在这里！ ♪ 第一个任务，多么气派！ ♪\n♪ 被派往那片废土！♪

EN: ♪ Overseer took me in ♪ When I was but an orphan ♪\n♪ Coming in from the Wasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 监督者收留了我 ♪ 那时我不过是个孤儿 ♪\n♪ 我来自那废土！♪

EN: ♪ Now I've grown, it's my chance ♪ To explore the expanse! ♪\n♪ Of the great, savage Wasteland ♪
ZH: ♪ 如今我已长大，这是我的机会 ♪ 去探索那浩瀚无垠！ ♪\n♪ 这伟大蛮荒的废土♪

EN: ♪ It's okay, I don't mind ♪ You never know what you'll find ♪\n♪ When you roam in the Wasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 没事，我不介意 ♪ 你永远不知道会发现什么 ♪\n♪ 当你漫游在废土！♪

EN: ♪ Don't worry, we're all good ♪\n♪ We'll be in the neighborhood! ♪
ZH: ♪ 别担心，我们都没事 ♪\n♪ 我们就在附近！♪

EN: ♪ Then we're sorry, you're no good ♪\n♪ We'd kill you twice if twice we could! ♪
ZH: ♪ 那就抱歉，你没用了 ♪\n♪ 若能杀你两次，我们绝不含糊！♪

EN: ♪ Stop right there, hold your fire ♪\n♪ It's all for the greater good! ♪
ZH: ♪ 站住别动，停止开火 ♪\n♪ 这都是为了大家好！♪

EN: ♪ Don't despair, get inspired ♪\n♪ And come join the Brotherhood! ♪
ZH: ♪ 别绝望，打起精神 ♪\n♪ 来加入兄弟会吧！♪

EN: ♪ Clad in steel, hard and strong ♪\n♪ Don't fear us yet? You should! ♪
ZH: ♪ 身披钢铁，坚硬强壮 ♪\n♪ 还不怕我们吗？你们该惊慌！♪

EN: ♪ If you feel you don't belong ♪\n♪ Come and join the Brotherhood! ♪
ZH: ♪ 如果你觉得自己不属于这里 ♪\n♪ 就来加入兄弟会吧！♪

EN: ♪ What an offer, how to say no? ♪ But not right now, I've got to go! ♪
ZH: ♪ 这么好的提议，怎能说不？ ♪ 但不是现在，我得走了！♪

EN: ♪ And what if my long-lost parents ♪ Say, just happened to be mutants? ♪
ZH: ♪ 万一我失散多年的父母 ♪ 比方说，碰巧就是变种人？♪

EN: ♪ That is something we can't do ♪\n♪ Now we'll turn you into stew! ♪
ZH: ♪ 这些事我们可做不到 ♪\n♪ 现在就把你炖了！♪

EN: ♪ Now you've done it, prep a casket! ♪\n♪ You had your laugh, now you die! ♪
ZH: ♪ 这下你闯祸了，备口棺材！ ♪\n♪ 你笑够了，现在去死吧！♪

EN: ♪ Doo-wop-wop, that's our song ♪\n♪ Don't you dare to sing along! ♪
ZH: ♪ 嘟哇哇，那是我们的歌 ♪\n♪ 想跟着唱？你敢试试！♪

EN: ♪ Others have tried before you ♪\n♪ We turned them to barbecue! ♪
ZH: ♪ 在你之前，有人试过 ♪\n♪ 我们把他们都变成了烤肉！♪

EN: ♪ Rama Lama Ding Ding Dong ♪\nSing our song and you'll be gone ♪
ZH: ♪ 拉玛拉玛叮叮咚 ♪\n跟着唱我们的歌，你就完蛋了♪
